text:

Stopping antidepressants suddenly can also cause real problems. These include withdrawal-like symptoms such as dizziness, nausea, irritability, "brain zaps" and trouble sleeping. Your depression or anxiety can also come back, sometimes worse than before. If you want to come off them, the safe way is a gradual taper that your prescriber plans with you.
